name: Mill Creek
seo_title: 4 Christmas Events for Kids in Mill Creek, WA 2026
seo_desc: 4 Christmas events for kids in Mill Creek, WA, 1 free: Breakfast with Santa at La Palmera Mill Creek and more.
lede: Mill Creek packs Christmas into Town Center: Santa rolls down Main Street in a parade, the city lights its tree at Jewelry Source Plaza, and restaurants and the recreation department add Santa breakfasts and cookie classes.
celebrates: The big day is Holidays on Main: Santa's Coming to Town Center, presented by the City of Mill Creek and the Mill Creek Chamber of Commerce. The Chamber runs Santa's Snowflake Village and Santa photos at The Forum, then the Santa Parade heads south on Main Street to Jewelry Source Plaza, where the city lights its tree. A new Royal Christmas Court of local residents rides in the parade. Earlier that day La Palmera serves Breakfast with Santa, and Mill Creek Recreation books holiday cookie decorating classes at City Hall North. City Hall also collects gifts for veterans at its Heroes Cafe Giving Tree.
lastyear: On Saturday, December 6, 2025, Mill Creek moved its tree lighting to a new spot, Jewelry Source Plaza at 15603 Main Street. The city set up a tent in Town Center from 3 to 6 pm where families picked up a commemorative tree ornament while supplies lasted. Santa rolled in with the Santa Parade and helped light the new tree, joined by Mayor Brian Holtzclaw and the Voices Northwest Chorus. That month the Heroes Cafe Giving Tree collected more than 270 pairs of socks and over $675 in gift cards for local veterans.
facts: Mill Creek began as a plan. Developers first proposed a planned community called Olympus in 1966, but it stalled. A new owner, United Development, renamed it Klahanie and then Mill Creek. Small logging and shingle mills had dotted the land in the early 1900s. Families moved in starting in 1976, around a golf course and country club. Mill Creek became a city on September 30, 1983, after a 453 to 324 vote, and one tied council race was settled with a coin toss.
trains: Mill Creek has no train station of its own, but rail is close. Link light rail reaches Lynnwood City Center Station, which opened in August 2024 on the 1 Line extension that also added stops in Mountlake Terrace and Shoreline. Sounder N Line commuter trains run from Everett, Mukilteo and Edmonds to King Street Station in Seattle, and Amtrak Cascades stops at Everett and Edmonds. For a Christmas train ride, the Northwest Railway Museum in Snoqualmie has run Santa Trains every December since 1969.

traditions: Santa rides south on Main Street through Mill Creek Town Center, with local groups and businesses in the parade.
Tree lighting at Jewelry Source Plaza
The City of Mill Creek lights its Christmas tree right after the parade, at the plaza where the route ends.
The Mill Creek Chamber of Commerce sets up a holiday village and Santa photos at The Forum in Town Center.
In 2025 the city handed out a commemorative tree ornament at its Town Center tent while supplies lasted.
Mill Creek Recreation books Christmas cookie decorating classes with Sprinkle Sisters at City Hall North, including one for kids with an adult.
City Hall collects socks, gloves, hats and gift cards for local veterans from Veterans Day through mid December.
kidfact: When Mill Creek became a city in 1983, two people tied in a race for the city council. They settled it with a coin toss, and the man who called heads won.
faq: When is the Mill Creek Santa Parade?

The Santa Parade is part of Holidays on Main, which takes place on the first Saturday in December in Mill Creek Town Center. The parade starts at 4 pm near 15024 Main Street and heads south to Jewelry Source Plaza at 15603 Main Street, where the city lights its tree about an hour later.
Where can kids get photos with Santa in Mill Creek?

During Holidays on Main, the Mill Creek Chamber of Commerce runs Santa photos at The Forum, 15121 Main Street, next to Santa's Snowflake Village. La Palmera in Town Center also hosts a ticketed Breakfast with Santa with photos, a hot cocoa bar and a Letters to Santa station.
Does Mill Creek have holiday classes for kids?

Yes. Mill Creek Recreation lists Christmas cookie decorating classes taught by Sprinkle Sisters at City Hall North, 15720 Main Street. The kids class is for ages 6 and up, and one registration covers one adult and one child decorating together. Register through the city's ActiveNet site.
Where did the Mill Creek tree lighting move?

In 2025 the city moved its tree lighting to Jewelry Source Plaza at 15603 Main Street, at the south end of the Santa Parade route. The city said the new tree, the lighting and the new location were a huge hit with the crowd that came out for the Santa Parade.
How do we get to Mill Creek by train?

Mill Creek has no rail station. The closest Link light rail stop is Lynnwood City Center Station on the 1 Line, and Sounder N Line commuter trains stop in Everett, Mukilteo and Edmonds. Amtrak Cascades also stops at Everett and Edmonds, so check a trip planner for the bus link from there.
